about: Way2Sec birthday greetings: PM, Telangana + Andhra Pradesh CMs, Dy CMs, ministers, MLAs and MPs. dob = YYYY-MM-DD (or --MM-DD if the year is unknown). verified=true only when a reputable/official source in dob_src states the date. last_posted = year of the last greeting (prevents repeats). photo = path to a photo the user supplied (never download leaders' photos).
